title: 谁第一个发现恐龙 · 素材
subtitle: 给对比页用的单体素材
style: children's picture book illustration, coloured pencil drawing with visible hatching strokes and grainy layered colour, warm ochre, moss green and brick red

pages.scene: One single fossil tooth lying flat, seen from the side, wide and flat like a leaf with a row of small points along one edge, its whole shape inside the picture. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.

One single green iguana lizard standing on four legs, seen from the side facing left, its whole body inside the picture. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.

One single iguanodon standing on four legs, seen from the side facing left, a pointed spike on each thumb, its whole body inside the picture. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.

One single grey lump of broken road stone lying on the ground, seen from the side, its whole shape inside the picture. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.
